build_simclr_loss: build a python module to instantiate the SimCLR Loss class with a given batch size and temperature
run_loss_cosine_similarity: run the Loss class with cosine similarity to compute contrastive loss on message and receiver output tensors
run_loss_dot_similarity: run the Loss class with dot product similarity to compute contrastive loss on message and receiver output tensors
review_loss_call: review the Loss __call__ method that computes positive and negative sample pairs for contrastive learning
test_loss_class: test the Loss class by passing mock tensors for message and receiver_output and verifying loss and accuracy output
